sources.title: Structure and function of haemoglobins.
sources.text:
Structure and function of haemoglobins.
Haemoglobin (Hb) is widely known as the iron-containing protein in blood that is essential for O 2  transport in mammals. Less widely recognised is that erythrocyte Hb belongs to a large family of Hb proteins with members distributed across all three domains of life-bacteria, archaea and eukaryotes. This review, aimed chiefly at researchers new to the field, attempts a broad overview of the diversity, and common features, in Hb structure and function. Topics include structural and functional classification of Hbs; principles of O 2  binding affinity and selectivity between O 2 [internal path] and other small ligands; hexacoordinate (containing bis-imidazole coordinated haem) Hbs; bacterial truncated Hbs; flavohaemoglobins; enzymatic reactions of Hbs with bioactive gases, particularly NO, and protection from nitrosative stress; and, sensor Hbs. A final section sketches the evolution of work on the structural basis for allosteric O 2  binding by mammalian R

QC inputReads is the input count; readsAfterQC is the count after quality control; readsAfterHostRemoval is the remaining count after host removal. Null means unavailable, not zero. Ask the assistant in chat to pull sample files or push results to a named project and sample. Agent runs and downloaded artifacts remain associated with your account. Changing pages updates context; it does not cancel a running analysis.

pipelines.name: bacterial_biosynthetic_gene_clusters
pipelines.description: Detect bacterial biosynthetic gene clusters from an assembled genome FASTA or raw reads using antiSMASH or GECCO.
use_when: the user wants bacterial secondary-metabolite or biosynthetic gene cluster detection
the user has an assembled genome FASTA or single-end/paired-end sequencing reads
avoid_when: the user only needs read quality control or taxonomic identification
the user wants defense-system or secretion-system annotation
pipelines.input_summary: One required genome FASTA or read 1 FASTQ as the main input, an optional read 2 FASTQ for metagenome mode, and the BacBGC task image.
pipelines.output_summary: BGC cluster, gene, and feature tables.
pipelines.limitations: Set input_type to genome for an assembled FASTA or metagenome for read 1 with optional read 2. Metagenome mode runs fastp and MEGAHIT before antiSMASH/GECCO. Results depend on image, resources, contig length, and backend/database behavior.

sequence_file1.label: Main sequence file
sequence_file1.description: Assembled genome FASTA in genome mode, or read 1 FASTQ in metagenome mode.

sequence_file2.label: Read 2 FASTQ (optional)
sequence_file2.description: Optional paired-end read 2 used only in metagenome mode

pipelines.name: bacterial_defense_system_annotation
pipelines.description: Identify bacterial defense systems and associated genes from an assembled genome FASTA or raw reads with DefenseFinder.
use_when: the user wants bacterial defense-system annotation or DefenseFinder results
the user has an assembled genome FASTA or single-end/paired-end sequencing reads
avoid_when: the user only needs read quality control, taxonomic identification, or biosynthetic gene cluster detection
the user wants TCDB, phage, or general functional annotation
pipelines.input_summary: One required genome FASTA or read 1 FASTQ as the main input, an optional read 2 FASTQ for metagenome mode, and a mounted DefenseFinder models directory.
pipelines.output_summary: Defense-system calls, defense-associated genes, and raw HMMER hit tables.
pipelines.limitations: Set input_type to genome for an assembled FASTA or metagenome for read 1 with optional read 2. Metagenome mode runs fastp and MEGAHIT before DefenseFinder. The DefenseFinder models directory and the BacDef image must be available to the Cromwell task container.

sequence_file1.label: Main sequence file
sequence_file1.description: Assembled genome FASTA in genome mode, or read 1 FASTQ in metagenome mode.

sequence_file2.label: Read 2 FASTQ (optional)
sequence_file2.description: Optional paired-end read 2 used only in metagenome mode.

pipelines.name: bacterial_functional_annotation
pipelines.description: Annotate bacterial genes and assign functional terms from contigs or reads using the bundled functional-annotation workflow.
use_when: the user wants gene function or orthology annotations from bacterial sequence data
avoid_when: the user needs a complete taxonomic classification or abundance estimate
pipelines.input_summary: Bacterial contigs, reads, or a supported batch directory, with configured functional reference resources.
pipelines.output_summary: Gene annotations, functional term assignments, QC metrics, and run status.
pipelines.limitations: Provides functional annotation evidence and does not infer abundance, taxonomy, or biological conclusions.

input_data.label: Input file or directory
input_data.description: Sequence input accepted by this workflow.

pipelines.name: bacterial_genome_annotation
pipelines.description: Annotate assembled bacterial contigs with Prokka or Bakta and normalize the results into sequence, feature, report, metrics, and archive artifacts.
use_when: the user has assembled bacterial contigs and wants gene or feature annotation
avoid_when: the input is raw reads
the user requests comparative variant analysis
pipelines.input_summary: One assembled bacterial contigs FASTA file and an annotator selection with optional organism metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: GFF, GenBank, protein, nucleotide, feature-table, report, metrics, log, and raw-output archive files.
pipelines.limitations: Annotation quality depends on the selected tool and database versions.

genome.label: Assembled bacterial genome
genome.description: Assembled bacterial contigs in FASTA format.

pipelines.name: bacterial_secretion_system_annotation
pipelines.description: Identify bacterial secretion systems and associated genes from an assembled genome FASTA or raw reads with MacSyFinder TXSScan.
use_when: the user wants bacterial secretion-system annotation or TXSScan results
the user has an assembled genome FASTA or single-end/paired-end sequencing reads
avoid_when: the user only needs read quality control, taxonomic identification, or biosynthetic gene cluster detection
the user wants defense-system or general functional annotation
pipelines.input_summary: One required genome FASTA or read 1 FASTQ as the main input, an optional read 2 FASTQ for metagenome mode, and a mounted TXSScan models directory.
pipelines.output_summary: Secretion-system calls and secretion-associated gene tables.
pipelines.limitations: Set input_type to genome for an assembled FASTA or metagenome for read 1 with optional read 2. Metagenome mode runs fastp and MEGAHIT before MacSyFinder. The TXSScan models directory and the BacSec image must be available to the Cromwell task container.

sequence_file1.label: Main sequence file
sequence_file1.description: Assembled genome FASTA in genome mode, or read 1 FASTQ in metagenome mode.

sequence_file2.label: Read 2 FASTQ (optional)
sequence_file2.description: Optional paired-end read 2 used only in metagenome mode.

pipelines.name: bacterial_viral_variant_analysis
pipelines.description: Call mutations from one bacterial or viral FASTQ sample or assembled genome FASTA.
use_when: the user wants bacterial or viral SNP and variant results from one sample
the user has single-end or paired-end FASTQ reads, or one assembled genome FASTA
avoid_when: the user wants a multi-sample phylogenetic tree
the user wants molecular typing or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: One FASTQ read file or assembled FASTA, optional read 2 for metagenome mode, and an optional reference FASTA.
pipelines.output_summary: SNP matrix or alignment, variants TSV, and variants summary.
pipelines.limitations: The matrix output is TSV or FASTA according to the selected mode. Reference databases must be visible to the Cromwell task container. This WDL skips tree building.

sequence_file1.label: Read 1 FASTQ or assembled genome FASTA
sequence_file1.description: FASTQ in metagenome mode or one assembly FASTA in genome mode.

sequence_file2.label: Optional read 2 FASTQ
sequence_file2.description: Paired-end read 2; use only with metagenome input_type.

reference_fasta.label: Optional reference FASTA
reference_fasta.description: Local reference sequence when not resolving one from a configured database.

pipelines.name: genomic_pathogen_identification
pipelines.description: Identify likely bacterial, fungal, parasitic, and viral pathogens from an assembled or consensus FASTA using Mash sketches and configured annotation tables.
use_when: the user has an assembled or consensus FASTA and wants Mash-based pathogen identification
the Mash databases and annotation tables are available at paths visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has raw FASTQ reads that still need quality control or assembly
the user wants a strain-level analysis, variant risk assessment, or unrestricted clinical diagnosis
pipelines.input_summary: One assembled or consensus FASTA; Mash databases and annotation files are deployment-managed resources.
pipelines.output_summary: Summary identification TSV, per-contig calls TSV, annotated hits TSV, and four Mash distance tables.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on the configured Mash databases, annotation releases, query FASTA quality, Docker image, resource allocation, and Cromwell execution. All reference files must already be visible inside the task container.

query_fasta.label: Query FASTA
query_fasta.description: Assembled or consensus nucleotide FASTA to identify.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_de_novo_assembly
pipelines.description: Assemble metagenomic reads, identify assembled contigs against configured reference databases, and produce contig- and species-level reports.
use_when: the user wants assembly and downstream identification from metagenomic reads
avoid_when: the user only needs read QC or host filtering
pipelines.input_summary: Single-end or paired-end FASTQ reads plus configured minimap2 indexes, annotations, and optional reference FASTA files.
pipelines.output_summary: Renamed assembled contigs, contig report, species report, and workflow-generated alignment artifacts.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on configured databases, Docker images, and Cromwell resources.

read2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
read2.description: Optional read 2 FASTQ input for paired-end processing.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_growth_rate_Calculation
pipelines.description: Estimate genome-by-sample replication rates as log2(PTR) from metagenomic reads with the configured CoPTR reference and index resources.
use_when: the user has single-end or paired-end metagenomic FASTQ reads and wants CoPTR replication-rate estimates
the CoPTR reference genomes and index are available at paths visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user still needs read quality control, adapter trimming, or host removal
the user wants taxonomic profiling, assembly, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2,  and sample parameters.
pipelines.output_summary: One CSV containing genome-by-sample log2(PTR) estimates.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on read quality, reference genomes, CoPTR index, minimum-read threshold, Docker image, and Cromwell execution. The reference and index directories must already be visible inside the task container.

read1.label: Read 1 FASTQ
read1.description: Required single-end read or paired-end read 1.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_pathogen_identification
pipelines.description: Identify bacterial, viral, fungal, and parasite signals from host-filtered reads using alignment, cross-database arbitration, and confidence filtering.
use_when: the user wants pathogen detection from cleaned metagenomic reads
avoid_when: the input has not completed the required quality and host-filtering preparation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, configured minimap2 indexes, annotation tables, and filtering parameters.
pipelines.output_summary: Confidence-filtered panel, priority panel, sample overview, and cross-database read-accounting tables.
pipelines.limitations: Detection depends on configured indexes, annotations, thresholds, and Cromwell container execution.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_pathogen_identification_kmer
pipelines.description: Classify cleaned metagenomic reads with StrobeTaxa k-mer and strobemer signatures.
use_when: the user has cleaned FASTQ reads and wants k-mer or strobemer based taxonomic detection
the StrobeTaxa database is available at a path visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user still needs read quality control or adapter trimming
the user needs assembly, pathogen strain identification, or clinical interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: One required cleaned R1 FASTQ, an optional cleaned R2 FASTQ, and a deployment-managed StrobeTaxa database directory.
pipelines.output_summary: Classified reads TSV, classification report TSV, and signature coverage CSV.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on the StrobeTaxa database, clean-read quality, Docker image, resource allocation, and Cromwell execution. The database directory must already be mounted into the task container.

clean_r1.label: Clean reads R1
clean_r1.description: Required cleaned single-end or paired-end R1 reads.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_pathogen_identification_marker
pipelines.description: Profile metagenomic reads with MetaPhlAn and generate sample marker and alignment outputs for downstream strain analysis.
use_when: the user has single-end or paired-end metagenomic FASTQ reads and wants MetaPhlAn-based community or strain profiling
the configured MetaPhlAn database is available at a path visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user still needs read quality control, adapter trimming, or host removal
the user wants de novo assembly, broad pathogen screening, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, MetaPhlAn database settings, and sample metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: MetaPhlAn profile, compressed SAM alignment, and consensus marker file.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on read quality, MetaPhlAn database release, database visibility, Docker image, and Cromwell execution. This workflow does not perform upstream read QC.

read1.label: Read 1 FASTQ
read1.description: Required single-end read or paired-end read 1.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_qc_UniVec_Host
pipelines.description: Trim adapters, remove configured host sequences and UniVec contaminants, and summarize read QC results for one metagenomic sample.
use_when: the user wants adapter trimming, host removal, or UniVec filtering for metagenomic FASTQ reads
the user has single-end or paired-end reads and the required host/UniVec resources are mounted
avoid_when: the user already has cleaned reads and only needs pathogen identification
the user wants genome assembly, taxonomic profiling, or variant interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, optional custom host FASTA, and deployment-managed host and UniVec resources.
pipelines.output_summary: Cleaned read files, one QC summary row, and a MultiQC HTML report.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on adapter sequences, host selection or custom host index, UniVec resources, Docker image, resource allocation, and Cromwell execution. Mounted indexes must be visible inside the task container.

read1.label: Read 1 FASTQ
read1.description: Required single-end read or paired-end read 1.

read2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
read2.description: Optional paired-end read 2; its presence selects paired-end processing.

host_fasta.label: Optional custom host FASTA
host_fasta.description: Optional host FASTA used to build a temporary Bowtie2 index when host_name is cleared.

pipelines.name: metagenomic_read_quality_control
pipelines.description: Filter metagenomic reads and remove host or vector sequences with fastp, Kraken2, and Bowtie2 before downstream analysis.
use_when: the user wants quality filtering and host removal from metagenomic reads
avoid_when: the user wants final pathogen identification or variant interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, mounted Kraken2 and Bowtie2 resources, and sample settings.
pipelines.output_summary: Cleaned reads, QC read counts, and phase-one read-overview tables.
pipelines.limitations: Reference databases, Docker images, and Cromwell service configuration must be available.

read2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
read2.description: Optional read 2 FASTQ input for paired-end processing.

pipelines.name: metax_classification_abundance_analysis
pipelines.description: Profile a single microbial sample with MetaX and return its taxonomic profile from short reads or an input sequence file.
use_when: the user wants MetaX taxonomic profiling for a single sample
the user has single-end or paired-end reads and the MetaX database is mounted
avoid_when: the user needs read quality control, host removal, or de novo assembly
the user wants clinical interpretation or variant calling
pipelines.input_summary: Required input sequence file, optional paired read 2, and mounted MetaX database and taxonomy resources.
pipelines.output_summary: One MetaX profile text table.
pipelines.limitations: The MetaX database JSON and optional NCBI taxdump must be visible inside the Cromwell task container. This workflow runs MetaX directly and does not perform upstream read QC or assembly.

reads.label: Input sequence or read 1
reads.description: Required input sequence file. Use this for single-end reads, paired-end read 1, or an input FASTA accepted by MetaX.

reads2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
reads2.description: Optional paired-end read 2. When provided, MetaX is run in paired mode.

pipelines.name: pathogen_variant_risk_assessment_consensus
pipelines.description: Analyze an existing pathogen consensus FASTA, annotate variants, and produce a pathogen-specific risk report.
use_when: the user already has a consensus FASTA and wants configured H1N1, H3N2, or SARS-CoV-2 variant risk analysis
the user does not need raw-read alignment or consensus generation
avoid_when: the user has raw FASTQ reads that still need variant calling
the user requests unsupported pathogens or unrestricted clinical diagnosis
pipelines.input_summary: One consensus FASTA and one supported pathogen; reference, snpEff, segment, and risk annotation resources are deployment-managed.
pipelines.output_summary: Final variant risk report and complete workflow output archive.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on the selected pathogen resources, consensus quality, Docker image, snpEff data, and Cromwell execution. This workflow consumes a consensus FASTA and does not generate one from reads.

consensus_fasta.label: Consensus FASTA
consensus_fasta.description: Consensus or assembled pathogen sequence in FASTA format.

pipelines.name: phi_annotator_genome
pipelines.description: Annotate an assembled genome or protein FASTA against PHI-base and produce pathogen-host interaction hits and a summary report.
use_when: the user has an assembled genome FASTA or a predicted protein FASTA and wants PHI-base annotation
the PHI-base DIAMOND database and metadata table are available to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has raw metagenomic reads and wants read-level PHI-base screening
the user wants read quality control, assembly, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Exactly one genome FASTA or protein FASTA, plus the mounted PHI-base DIAMOND database and metadata table.
pipelines.output_summary: PHI-base hit and summary tables, annotation QC/status files, a manifest, and a Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: The workflow does not assemble reads or perform read QC. Database paths and the pipeline directory must be visible inside the task container. Genome input runs Prodigal before DIAMOND; protein input skips gene prediction.

genome_fasta.label: Genome FASTA
genome_fasta.description: Assembled nucleotide FASTA. Provide this or protein_fasta, but not both.

protein_fasta.label: Protein FASTA
protein_fasta.description: Predicted protein FASTA. Provide this or genome_fasta, but not both.

pipelines.name: phi_annotator_metagenome
pipelines.description: Screen metagenomic FASTQ reads against PHI-base with DIAMOND blastx and produce read-level pathogen-host interaction annotations.
use_when: the user has single-end or paired-end metagenomic FASTQ reads and wants PHI-base read-level annotation
the PHI-base DIAMOND database and metadata table are available to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has an assembled genome and wants genome-level PHI-base annotation
the user wants read quality control, assembly, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, and the mounted PHI-base DIAMOND database and metadata table.
pipelines.output_summary: PHI-base hit, read-hit, and summary tables, annotation QC/status files, a manifest, and a Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: This workflow runs DIAMOND blastx directly on reads and does not assemble or perform upstream read QC. The optional R2 is scanned as an additional FASTQ and is not paired during annotation. Database paths and the pipeline directory must be visible inside the task container.

read1.label: Read 1 FASTQ
read1.description: Required single-end read or paired-end read 1.

read2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
read2.description: Optional second FASTQ. It is scanned together with read 1 without PE pairing.

pipelines.name: risk_screen
pipelines.description: Screen an assembled or consensus FASTA for biorisk, toxin-related, pathogen, and low-concern sequence signals using the configured ScreenMec databases.
use_when: the user has an assembled or consensus FASTA and wants biosafety or pathogen sequence screening
the ScreenMec databases, annotation files, and taxon data are available at paths visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has raw FASTQ reads that still need quality control or assembly
the user wants ordinary taxonomic profiling, strain typing, or unrestricted clinical interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: One assembled or consensus FASTA; ScreenMec databases, annotations, and taxon data are deployment-managed resources.
pipelines.output_summary: One ScreenMec TSV containing the cascaded biorisk, functional, pathogen, and low-concern screening results.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on the configured databases and annotations, query FASTA quality, Docker image, resource allocation, and Cromwell execution. All reference resources must already be visible inside the task container.

query_fasta.label: Query FASTA
query_fasta.description: Assembled or consensus nucleotide FASTA to screen.

pipelines.name: rna_secondary_structure_prediction
pipelines.description: Convert nucleotide FASTA records to RNA, predict minimum-free-energy secondary structures with RNAfold, and return structured reports.
use_when: the user wants secondary-structure predictions for RNA or DNA-letter nucleotide sequences
avoid_when: the user needs tertiary-structure modeling, pseudoknot prediction, or experimental interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: A nucleotide FASTA file within the configured record and length limits.
pipelines.output_summary: Structure table, dot-bracket file, metrics, report, and RNAfold log.
pipelines.limitations: The workflow predicts equilibrium minimum-free-energy structures and does not model cellular conditions or pseudoknots.

rna.label: RNA sequences
rna.description: One or more RNA or DNA-letter nucleotide sequences in FASTA format.

pipelines.name: tcdb_annotator_genome
pipelines.description: Annotate an assembled genome or protein FASTA against TCDB and produce transporter, transmembrane, and summary reports.
use_when: the user has an assembled genome FASTA or a predicted protein FASTA and wants TCDB annotation
the TCDB BLAST or DIAMOND databases and metadata table are available to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has raw metagenomic reads and wants read-level TCDB screening
the user wants read quality control, assembly, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Exactly one genome FASTA or protein FASTA, plus mounted TCDB BLAST/DIAMOND databases and metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: TCDB hit and summary tables, optional transmembrane predictions, annotation QC/status files, a manifest, and a Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: The workflow does not assemble reads or perform read QC. Database paths, TMbed model resources when enabled, and the pipeline directory must be visible inside the task container. Genome input runs Prodigal before protein alignment; protein input skips gene prediction.

genome_fasta.label: Genome FASTA
genome_fasta.description: Assembled nucleotide FASTA. Provide this or protein_fasta, but not both.

protein_fasta.label: Protein FASTA
protein_fasta.description: Predicted protein FASTA. Provide this or genome_fasta, but not both.

pipelines.name: tcdb_annotator_metagenome
pipelines.description: Screen metagenomic FASTQ reads against TCDB with DIAMOND blastx and produce read-level transporter annotations.
use_when: the user has single-end or paired-end metagenomic FASTQ reads and wants read-level TCDB annotation
the TCDB DIAMOND database and metadata table are available to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has an assembled genome and wants genome-level TCDB annotation
the user wants read quality control, assembly, or clinical risk interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Required read 1, optional read 2, and the mounted TCDB DIAMOND database and metadata table.
pipelines.output_summary: TCDB hit, read-hit, and summary tables, annotation QC/status files, a manifest, and a Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: This workflow runs DIAMOND blastx directly on reads and does not assemble or perform upstream read QC. The optional R2 is scanned as an additional FASTQ and is not paired during annotation. TMbed is disabled in this mode. Database paths and the pipeline directory must be visible inside the task container.

read1.label: Read 1 FASTQ
read1.description: Required single-end read or paired-end read 1.

read2.label: Read 2 FASTQ
read2.description: Optional second FASTQ. It is scanned together with read 1 without PE pairing.

pipelines.name: template_bio
pipelines.description: Educational shell template that demonstrates a complete DNA read-analysis artifact set without external bioinformatics tools.
use_when: the user requests a local demonstration of the pipeline runtime
the user wants to inspect example DNA analysis artifacts
avoid_when: the user needs validated alignment, variant calling, or research-grade interpretation
pipelines.input_summary: Single-end reads, one reference FASTA, and sample metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: QC metrics, demonstration alignments, consensus, variant-like records, tables, figures, and reports.

reads.label: Sequencing reads
reads.description: Single-end DNA reads with Phred+33 quality scores.

reference.label: Reference genome

metadata.label: Sample metadata
metadata.description: Sample sheet containing a sample_id column.

pipelines.name: template_nextflow
pipelines.description: Nextflow template that normalizes a FASTA sequence and reports basic sequence and metadata metrics.
use_when: the user requests a Nextflow runtime demonstration
avoid_when: the user needs a validated production sequence-analysis workflow
pipelines.input_summary: FASTA sequence and TSV/CSV metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: Normalized FASTA, metrics JSON, and Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: This is an educational workflow for testing the Nextflow engine.

metadata.label: Metadata table
metadata.description: TSV or CSV metadata associated with the sequence input.

pipelines.name: template_shell
pipelines.description: Small shell template that joins sequence IDs to metadata and writes normalized text, assignments, metrics, and a report.
use_when: the user wants sequence IDs matched to metadata categories
avoid_when: the user needs biological classification or sequence similarity analysis
pipelines.input_summary: Sequence text, FASTA, or FASTQ plus TSV/CSV metadata with matching identifier and category columns.
pipelines.output_summary: Normalized sequence text, assignment table, metrics, and report.
pipelines.limitations: The workflow performs deterministic metadata joining and does not infer biological subtypes.

reads.label: Sequence data
reads.description: Sequence reads supplied to the workflow.

metadata.label: Subtype metadata
metadata.description: TSV or CSV metadata associated with the sequence input.

pipelines.name: template_snakemake
pipelines.description: Snakemake template that normalizes a FASTA sequence and reports basic sequence and metadata metrics.
use_when: the user requests a Snakemake runtime demonstration
avoid_when: the user needs a validated production sequence-analysis workflow
pipelines.input_summary: FASTA sequence and TSV/CSV metadata.
pipelines.output_summary: Normalized FASTA, metrics JSON, and Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: This is an educational workflow for testing the Snakemake engine.

metadata.label: Metadata table
metadata.description: TSV or CSV metadata associated with the sequence input.

pipelines.name: template_wdl
pipelines.description: WDL template that normalizes a FASTA sequence and produces sequence metrics and a report.
use_when: the user requests a WDL runtime demonstration
avoid_when: the user needs a validated production sequence-analysis workflow
pipelines.input_summary: One FASTA sequence and optional WDL parameters.
pipelines.output_summary: Normalized FASTA, metrics JSON, and Markdown report.
pipelines.limitations: This is an educational workflow for testing WDL execution.

pipelines.name: traceback_covid19
pipelines.description: Compare a query sequence with a configured reference, calculate genotype distance with Valkyrie resources, derive an SNP sequence, and build a FastTree tree.
use_when: the user has a query FASTA and wants reference-based genotype distance, SNP sequence, and phylogenetic tree results
the configured Valkyrie and indel resources are available at paths visible to the Cromwell task container
avoid_when: the user has raw FASTQ reads that still need quality control or assembly
the user wants unrestricted clinical interpretation or a general pathogen screen
pipelines.input_summary: One query FASTA; the reference FASTA, Valkyrie files, and indel information are deployment-managed resources.
pipelines.output_summary: Combined FASTA, multiple-sequence alignment, mutation list, genotype distance results, SNP sequence, and FastTree Newick tree.
pipelines.limitations: Results depend on the configured reference and Valkyrie resources, method selection, Docker image, sequence quality, and Cromwell execution. The reference and supporting files must already be visible inside the task container.

query_fasta.label: Query FASTA
query_fasta.description: Query consensus or assembled nucleotide FASTA.

pipelines.name: viral_genome_molecular_typing
pipelines.description: Process an assembled or consensus viral FASTA and run configured Nextclade molecular typing.
use_when: the user already has a viral genome or consensus FASTA and wants influenza or SARS-CoV-2 molecular typing
the user does not need raw-read quality control or read alignment from FASTQ files
avoid_when: the user has raw FASTQ reads that still need read processing
the user requests an unsupported pathogen or an unrestricted clinical diagnosis
